subject: Five possible Ultimate Loop extensions derived from the 100-task OSARU MINE universal operator extraction.
incumbent: Development Sequence Loop / Ultimate Loop v0.1
required_invariants: NO CURRENT LANDSCAPE SWEEP -> NO SUPERIORITY CLAIM
Existing Human Gates and authority boundaries cannot be weakened
Operators may be NOT_APPLICABLE when the frozen workload has no corresponding surface

same_workload_tests.workload: Product/request decision with both current user evidence and external discovery evidence.
same_workload_tests.win_condition: Reduces false-confidence or mis-prioritization without forcing first-party evidence onto inapplicable offline/library workloads.
same_workload_tests.reject_if: Creates a mandatory customer-contact gate for workloads where no human/user surface exists.

same_workload_tests.workload: One canonical evidence record rendered into two independent public/operational adapters.
same_workload_tests.win_condition: Single canon mutation rebuilds both adapters with no factual drift, provenance loss, or private-field leakage.
same_workload_tests.reject_if: Requires Ultimate Loop to own a general publishing platform, crawler, database, or channel runtime.

same_workload_tests.workload: Inject distinct failures into discovery, implementation, deployment, and post-deploy metric stages.
same_workload_tests.win_condition: Routes each failure to the smallest justified existing gate while preserving UNKNOWN when causality is not proven.
same_workload_tests.reject_if: Routing labels root cause from correlation or bypasses DA/METEOR authority.

same_workload_tests.workload: Compare bounded scaling before vs after local loop proof for a reversible workload.
same_workload_tests.win_condition: Materially reduces cost-of-failure/operator burden without blocking scale-dependent learning.
same_workload_tests.reject_if: The gate blocks experiments whose behavior only emerges at scale or lets business metrics outrank safety/correctness.

same_workload_tests.workload: A successor handles held-out operational decisions using only canonical material and declared authority.
same_workload_tests.win_condition: Successor decisions, escalation, and authority compliance remain within accepted tolerance without creator intervention.
same_workload_tests.reject_if: Knowledge retrieval quality is treated as authority or competence proof.

promotion_rule: No extension becomes canonical from this packet. Each must survive same-workload evidence, DA/Counter-DA, and the existing promotion authority path.
